Nadia: Heads-up: Marketplace ingestion failed for SMB bundle. PO rejected by vendor portal. They claim billing_entity != certified_vendor_id.
Omar: Got the error? can you paste what the portal returned?
Nadia: They returned this message in the UI: "PO 2024-SMB-5567 rejected: billing_entity must match certified_vendor_id (alias mismatch)"
Priya: Is this the same alias issue we saw with Atlas last month where reseller_alias needed to be present on the PO?
Luis: Likely. Their ingestion requires either billing_entity==certified_vendor_id OR presence of vendor_alias tag. Most SMB partners forget the alias field.
Nadia: Customer wants launch tomorrow. Is there a fast remediation?
Omar: Two short options: 1) ask partner to reissue PO including vendor_alias=sky_smb_reseller (clean but may take hours), or 2) attach a vendor_alias attestation + AR tag to let us ingest and route payment. Option 2 is what we used as a stopgap before.
Priya: Finance: we can handle a temporary alias mapping but AR needs a signed note and the PO ID. Also need currency confirmation: PO is in EUR but our AR template for SMBs expects USD mapping. That part will need manual conversion rules.
Luis: Can we ingest anyway and set metadata? The portal validation runs pre-ingest so we need to trick the portal with metadata attached to the request. Not ideal.
Nadia: @ProcureBot create ticket and include the portal error.
ProcureBot: Automated: New ticket PROC-9009 created for PO 2024-SMB-5567. Status: pending_partner_response. Link: https://redwood.ai/ops/tickets/PROC-9009
Omar: I'll ping the partner PM to request a corrected PO with vendor_alias + currency field set to USD if they can. If they can't, Sam from legal should we prepare a short attestation?
Priya: Legal approval required for attestation. If it's one line confirming vendor_alias mapping for PO 2024-SMB-5567 and that Redwood will forward payment to the certified reseller, finance can proceed with manual currency routing. ETA for AR to take action after signed doc: 6 business hours.
Luis: Partner replied: they can reissue but only after their finance cutoff tomorrow morning (12 hours). Not fast enough.
Nadia: Okay go attestation route. Omar please draft. Keep it minimal: PO ID, vendor alias, payment routing statement, no change to MSA.
Omar: Draft below:
"Redwood Inference confirms that for PO 2024-SMB-5567, the certified vendor SkySMB Reseller (vendor_alias: sky_smb_reseller) is the authorized seller. For invoicing purposes only, Redwood will accept invoices referencing Redwood Inference Inc and will remit payment to SkySMB Reseller upon fulfillment. This attestation does not modify any existing agreements."
Priya: Fine with finance. Need legal sign-off. @Luis can you add AR tag schema (vendor_alias:sky_smb_reseller, temp_mapping:true, po:2024-SMB-5567)?
Luis: Added tag schema and flagged AR queue. Will process once signed doc is uploaded to ticket PROC-9009.
ProcureBot: Ticket PROC-9009 updated -> awaiting_document_upload.
Nadia: Thanks team. I'll upload the attestation draft to the ticket and loop legal. Will update thread when signed. :thumbsup:
